column2: # Three checks that justify the design, written out as tables rather than left as
# by-products of the figures. All on PER-MUSSEL MEANS (one value per mussel per phase), for
# adhesion, peak force, plaque area and extension.
#       The day-0 lab-reference animals (T001-T012) never entered the experimental system;
#       the day-1 pre-exposure animals had been in the shared holding system for a day; the
#       day-3 treatment-control animals spent three days in a tank under ambient conditions.
#       If handling and time in the system did not move attachment, the three groups should
#       agree. Welch t and Mann-Whitney per metric: lab vs pre, day-3 control vs pre,
#       Arms were assigned at random after the baseline pull, so the per-mussel baseline
#       should not differ by FUTURE arm. One-way ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis per metric. This is
#       the per-mussel companion of the lmer `emm_base` randomization check above and the
#       justification for reading the within-animal change.
#       Pairing only buys power if an animal's attachment is repeatable. Two views:
#       - ICC from the mixed model's variance components, var(mussel) / (var(mussel) +
#         var(residual)), for the same arm x timepoint model as Statistics 2 (thread level;
#       - per-arm Pearson and Spearman correlation of the paired animals' baseline and day-3
names(thread_plot))   # extension is optional in the curated table
summarise(n_threads = n(), across(all_of(metric_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
mean_a = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE), mean_b = mean(b, na.rm = TRUE),
median_a = median(a, na.rm = TRUE), median_b = median(b, na.rm = TRUE),
diff_a_minus_b = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(b, na.rm = TRUE),
welch_p    = if (ok) t.test(a, b, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value else NA_real_,
wilcoxon_p = if (ok) suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b, paired = FALSE)$p.value) else NA_real_)
a <- anova(lm(reformulate("mussel_trt", response = m), data = d))
k <- kruskal.test(reformulate("mussel_trt", response = m), data = d)
summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(.data[[m]]), sd = sd(.data[[m]]), median = median(.data[[m]]),
mutate(anova_F = a[["F value"]][1], anova_df = paste(a$Df, collapse = ","), anova_p = a[["Pr(>F)"]][1],
# ---- 3c repeatability: ICC and per-arm pre/post correlation ---------------------------
c(icc = v_m / (v_m + v_r), var_mussel = v_m, var_residual = v_r)
tibble(metric = sp$metric, scale = sp$scale, statistic = "ICC_mussel_lmer", arm = "all",
d <- if (a == "all") paired_pm else paired_pm %>% filter(mussel_trt == a)
sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
bind_rows(tibble(metric = m, scale = "raw", statistic = "corr_pre_post_pearson", arm = a,
n = length(x), n_threads = NA_integer_, value = unname(pe$estimate),
var_mussel = NA_real_, var_residual = NA_real_, p = pe$p.value),
tibble(metric = m, scale = "raw", statistic = "corr_pre_post_spearman", arm = a,
n = length(x), n_threads = NA_integer_, value = unname(sp$estimate),
var_mussel = NA_real_, var_residual = NA_real_, p = sp$p.value))
